item.title: Russian drone attack on Dnipro train station kills at least 14
item.description: At least 14 people were killed and 14 others wounded, including an 11-year-old boy, when a Russian jet-powered drone struck the main railway station in the central Ukrainian city of Dnipro on Thursday, local officials said. item.title: HHS temporarily allows compounding pharmacies to produce six unapproved peptides
item.description: The Department of Health and Human Services has issued a policy that will temporarily allow state-licensed compounding pharmacies, federal facilities, and licensed physicians to manufacture six unapproved peptides — BPC-157, Epitalon, KPV, MOTS-c, Semax, and TB-500 — without facing federal…

item.title: Aid mission set to enter Oleshky as localized Russia-Ukraine truce holds for third day
